MM Simulations Releases Skiathos International Airport for MSFS 2024

September 28, 2026
Olai Dreisbach
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:42
Instaread

MM Simulations has today released Skiathos Alexandros Papadiamantis Airport (IATA: JSI, ICAO: LGSK) for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, the first new Skiathos scenery for the sim in quite a while.

Skiathos, a tourist hotspot and a famous planespotter location, is known for low, waterfront approaches, where the watching public can stand right next to the runway threshold and watch traffic come in and depart.

The airport is also particularly challenging to land at, requiring special training and having a short, non-Instrument Landing System-equipped runway.

MM Simulations’ scenery is for MSFS 2024 only, built natively for that platform, with a “highly detailed terminal,” ATC tower interiors, various handcrafted buildings and assets, custom ground textures and custom surroundings, and more.

The feature list, as published on the Contrail store page, is below:

Key Features

  • ✈️ Detailed recreation of LGSK Skiathos Airport
  • 🏢 Highly detailed terminal interiors
  • 🛣️ Custom ground markings and airport details
  • 🚒 Custom airport buildings and facilities
  • 🗼 Detailed control tower interior
  • 🛬 Handcrafted runway and surrounding terrain
  • 🏝️ Custom local landmarks and surroundings
  • 💡 Realistic night lighting
  • 🎮 Native Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 scenery

The airport opened in 1972 and is now privately operated by Fraport AG, with flights to destinations across Europe, especially by leisure and charter airlines.

It is located on a reclaimed landmass, between two former islands, roughly 4.5 km (2.8 mi) northeast of Skiathos city.

MM Simulations Skiathos is available on Contrail, simMarket, Orbx and iniBuilds, for about $17 USD (€15 EUR).
